title: Snarky Label Content System
keyDecisions: Module lives at lib/content.ts; separate from lib/playoff-labels.ts
Primary export is a Record<string, SnarkyLabel> map for O(1) key lookup
Tone type is 'positive' | 'sting' | 'neutral' (UX spec 'Neutral/fun' resolved to 'neutral')
14 label entries fully specified with UPPER_SNAKE_CASE keys
No React, no use client directive, no Zod, no database access
as const or readonly enforced for immutability
